liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Row Jimmy** (2 reviews): Row Jimmy in the first set is called fantastic; Row Jimmy is an excellent version, with a flute-like sound in its first half [18][21]
- **The Other One** (2 reviews): The Other One shook the entire stadium; The Other One is likewise named as redeeming an otherwise unremarkable show [12][13]
- **Walkin' Blues** (1 review): Walkin' Blues in the first set is called fantastic [18]
- **Althea** (1 review): Althea is named as worth the download [20]
- **Help on the Way** (1 review): Help>Slip>Frank is called one of the best from the late period [17]
- **Slipknot!** (1 review): Vince's playing on Slipknot! impressed the reviewer, who says he really can play sometimes [18]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Jerry's licks on Looks Like Rain are praised, with a claim that Trey's sound echoes them [20]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Terrapin Station is singled out as redeeming a show the reviewer calls weak [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **Hot Slots Jam**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **Elvis Space**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]

## The recordings

- **gd93-05-16.sbd.herman.11934.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 161 min; rated 4.13/5 by 29 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard sound quality outstanding [13]
- **gd1993-05-16.151684.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 155 min [8]. Said about its sound: Reversed channels in set 1 were fixed and levels raised in both sets [8]
- **gd1993-05-16.sbd.miller.tetzeli.fix-32348.34826.reflac.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 154 min [11]
- **gd1993-05-16.116301.NeumannKMF4.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 144 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [2]

## Around the show

- Bobby was struggling with vocal cord trouble and some lyrics were flubbed [12]
- Jerry was in high spirits, grinning broadly and spinning a full turn on stage, with his briefcase nearby [15]
- The first set had only six songs, and Bobby's voice was badly worn [19]
- Jerry remembered the words and noodled between nearly every song in the second set [19]
- The short first set is top notch up through Cassidy [21]
- The band seemed to wait on Bob before starting after the break, and Jerry seemed irritated [23]
- With Bob's voice ragged, Jerry took some of the vocal load off him [23]
- This Help>Slip>Frank is a precursor to the huge version played in Eugene three months later [12]
- Reviewer ranks it among the better shows of the band's last consistent year [17]
- Reviewer rates it the best show of that year's Vegas run by a mile [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd93-05-16.sbd.herman.11934.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>DAT(48kHz) [1]. Also: Soundboard transferred to DAT at 48kHz, via Steve Herman, and seeded to etree by M. Walke [1]
- **gd1993-05-16.151684.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  December 31, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [8]. Also: Remaster of the uploader's earlier source, using multiple masters to make the show complete [8]
- **gd1993-05-16.sbd.miller.tetzeli.fix-32348.34826.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Fix of shnid 32348 [11]. Also: Continuity between CDs 2 and 3 was restored, with overlapping fade tracks added that can be removed for seamless playback [11]
- **gd1993-05-16.116301.NeumannKMF4.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: source: 2 Neumann KMF4 microphones > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by www.gdao.org: [Grateful Dead, Sting. Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, Las Vegas, Nevada, May 14-16, 1993 · Grateful Dead Archive Online · Grateful](https://www.gdao.org/items/show/377250) [25]
- Poster by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1993-05-15 Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, U.N.L.V., Las Vegas, NV, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1993-05-15-sam-boyd-silver-bowl-u-n-l-v-las-vegas-nv-usa/) [26]
